8: # 精简 JSON 样例跨语言一致 / 存储替身双语言同布局互读。
9: #
10: # 用法：bash backend/tests/run-acceptance.sh
11: # 前置：mvp-a-pg 隔离容器（deploy/dev/pg-up.sh）、docker、mvn、java 21、

15: # 每次运行新建 mvp_a_accept_<hex8> + 独立 /tmp 存储根，trap 清理；可重复执行。
16: # 退出码：任一 FAIL → 非 0。
17: # =====================================================================
18: set -euo pipefail
19: 
20: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
21: BACKEND="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
22: DEV="$BACKEND/deploy/dev"
23: SUPPORT="$SCRIPT_DIR/support"

25: WORKERPY="$BACKEND/worker-python"

31: PG_HOST_PORT="${MVP_A_PG_HOST_PORT:-55432}"
32: PG_USER="${MVP_A_PG_USER:-postgres}"
33: PG_PASSWORD="${MVP_A_PG_PASSWORD:-mvp_a_local}"
34: APP_PORT="${ACCEPT_APP_PORT:-18080}"

36: SUFFIX="$(openssl rand -hex 4)"
37: ACCEPT_DB="mvp_a_accept_${SUFFIX}"
38: # 运行/存储临时目录：worktree 内专用目录（backend/tests/.work/，非 /tmp）。
39: # trap 仅清理本轮自建且路径前缀归属明确的目录；可用 ACCEPT_RUN_BASE 覆盖。
40: RUN_BASE="${ACCEPT_RUN_BASE:-$SCRIPT_DIR/.work}"
41: mkdir -p "$RUN_BASE"
42: STORAGE_ROOT="$RUN_BASE/storage-${SUFFIX}"

44: mkdir -p "$TMP"
45: JAR="$WEBJAVA/target/web-java-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar"
46: 
47: # ---------------- 颜色与结果登记 ----------------
48: if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
49:   C_G=$'\e[32m'; C_R=$'\e[31m'; C_B=$'\e[1m'; C_D=$'\e[2m'; C_0=$'\e[0m'
50: else
51:   C_G=""; C_R=""; C_B=""; C_D=""; C_0=""
52: fi
53: RESULTS=()   # "id|desc|acceptance|PASS|FAIL"
54: overall_rc=0
55: 
56: vlog() { printf '     %s\n' "$*"; }
57: 
58: check() { # check <id> <desc> <acceptance-item> <fn...>：子 shell 内 set -e 执行
59:   local id="$1" desc="$2" acc="$3"; shift 3
60:   local logf="$TMP/${id}.log" rc=0
61:   ( set -e; "$@" ) >"$logf" 2>&1 || rc=$?
62:   if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
63:     printf '%s[PASS]%s %-3s %s\n' "$C_G" "$C_0" "$id" "$desc"
64:     sed 's/^/       /' "$logf" | grep -v '^\s*$' || true
65:     RESULTS+=("$id|$desc|$acc|PASS")
66:   else
67:     overall_rc=1
68:     printf '%s[FAIL]%s %-3s %s (rc=%d) — 最近日志:\n' "$C_R" "$C_0" "$id" "$desc" "$rc"
69:     tail -n 15 "$logf" | sed 's/^/       | /'
70:     RESULTS+=("$id|$desc|$acc|FAIL")
71:   fi
72: }
73: 
74: fail() { echo "ASSERT-FAIL: $*" >&2; exit 1; }  # exit 只结束 check 子壳（确定性失败传播）
75: 
76: # ---------------- psql 辅助（一律走 docker exec 到隔离容器） ----------------
77: psql_t() { docker exec -i "$PG_CONTAINER" psql -U "$PG_USER" -d "$1" -tA -c "$2"; }
78: 
79: expect_sql_error() { # <label> <db> <SQL> <expected-constraint-fragment>
80:   local label="$1" db="$2" sql="$3" want="$4" out rc=0
81:   out=$(docker exec -i "$PG_CONTAINER" psql -U "$PG_USER" -d "$db" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$sql" 2>&1) || rc=$?
82:   [[ $rc -ne 0 ]] || fail "$label：语句竟然成功（本应被拒绝）"
83:   grep -q "$want" <<<"$out" || fail "$label：报错未含 $want → $out"
84:   vlog "$label → 如期拒绝（$want）"
85: }

88: call() { # call <METHOD> <URL> [curl args...] → $CODE / $BODY
89:   local method="$1" url="$2"; shift 2

91:   CODE=$(curl -sS --noproxy '*' -o "$f" -w '%{http_code}' -X "$method" "$@" "$url" 2>/dev/null || echo 000)

93: }

96:   JGET_JSON="$BODY" "$CPY" - "$1" <<'PYEOF'
97: import json, os, sys
98: cur = json.loads(os.environ["JGET_JSON"])
99: for part in sys.argv[1].split('.'):
100:     if isinstance(cur, list):
101:         cur = cur[int(part)]
102:     elif isinstance(cur, dict) and part in cur:
103:         cur = cur[part]
104:     else:
105:         sys.exit(3)
106: print("true" if cur is True else ("false" if cur is False else ("null" if cur is None else cur)))
107: PYEOF
108: }

110:   local v
111:   v=$(jget "$1") || { echo "body: $BODY" >&2; exit 1; }
112:   printf '%s' "$v"
113: }

300: _app_launch() { # _app_launch <logfile>
301:   local logf="$1"
302:   nohup env \
303:     SERVER_PORT="$APP_PORT" \
304:     SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev \
305:     SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL="jdbc:postgresql://127.0.0.1:${PG_HOST_PORT}/${ACCEPT_DB}" \
306:     SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME="$PG_USER" \
307:     SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD="$PG_PASSWORD" \
308:     APP_STORAGE_DEV_DIR="$STORAGE_ROOT" \
309:     java -jar "$JAR" >"$logf" 2>&1 &
310:   echo $! > "$TMP/app.pid"
311: }
312: _app_wait_health() { # _app_wait_health <logfile>
313:   local logf="$1" i ok=0
314:   for i in $(seq 1 120); do
315:     if curl -sS --noproxy '*' -o "$TMP/health" "http://127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}/actuator/health" 2>/dev/null \
316:        && grep -q '"status":"UP"' "$TMP/health"; then ok=1; break; fi
317:     sleep 1
318:   done
319:   [[ $ok -eq 1 ]] || { tail -n 20 "$logf"; fail "app 未在 120s 内 UP"; }
320: }
321: _app_stop() {
322:   [[ -f "$TMP/app.pid" ]] || return 0
323:   local pid i; pid=$(cat "$TMP/app.pid")
324:   kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
325:   for i in $(seq 1 30); do kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 1; done
326:   if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fail "app 未在 30s 内退出"; fi
327:   rm -f "$TMP/app.pid"
328: }

87: def proj_verdict(status, requested_job, body, marker=None, forbid=()) -> tuple:
88:     """echo GET 投影判定：必须 200 + data.jobId==requested_job，再校验 closed enum。
89:     返回 True=PASS / False=FAIL / None=BLOCKED；**任何 jobId 不符或缺字段绝不 PASS**。"""
90:     if status != 200:
91:         return None, f"HTTP {status}（未取得目标资源）"
92:     d = (body or {}).get("data") or {}
93:     if not d.get("jobId"):
94:         return None, "缺 data.jobId 字段（不得 PASS）"
95:     if str(d["jobId"]) != str(requested_job):
96:         return False, f"data.jobId={d['jobId']} != 请求 {requested_job}（资源不匹配）"
97:     if "lastError" not in d:
98:         return None, "缺 data.lastError 字段（不得 PASS）"
99:     le = d["lastError"]
100:     if le is not None:
101:         if not isinstance(le, dict) or set(le.keys()) != {"reason", "retryable"}:
102:             return False, f"投影形状非 {{reason,retryable}}: {le!r}"
103:         if le["reason"] not in REASON_ENUM:
104:             return False, f"reason 非封闭枚举: {le['reason']!r}"
105:         if not isinstance(le["retryable"], bool):
106:             return False, "retryable 非 bool"
107:     raw = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False)
108:     for needle in forbid:
109:         if needle and needle in raw:
110:             return False, f"响应含禁止内容: {needle[:40]!r}"
111:     return True, f"jobId 匹配; lastError={le}"

114: def queued_verdict(status, requested_job, body) -> tuple:
115:     """RV-4 queued：200 + jobId 匹配 + status=='queued' + lastError/finishedAt 显式存在且 null。"""
116:     if status != 200:
117:         return None, f"HTTP {status}"
118:     d = (body or {}).get("data") or {}
119:     if not d.get("jobId"):
120:         return None, "缺 data.jobId 字段（不得 PASS）"
121:     if str(d["jobId"]) != str(requested_job):
122:         return False, f"data.jobId 不符（{d['jobId']} != {requested_job}）"
123:     if d.get("status") != "queued":
124:         return False, f"status={d.get('status')!r} != 'queued'"
125:     if "lastError" not in d or "finishedAt" not in d:
126:         return False, "缺 lastError/finishedAt 字段（不得以默认值冒充 null）"
127:     if d["lastError"] is not None or d["finishedAt"] is not None:
128:         return False, "queued 的 lastError/finishedAt 应为显式 null"
129:     return True, "jobId 匹配; status=queued; lastError=null; finishedAt=null"

1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
3: """a-reverify 哨兵：**入口 RUN_ID 绑定**校验。
4: 
5: run.sh a-reverify 在入口生成 RUN_ID（env 传驱动），驱动用该 RUN_ID 写哨兵与证据；
6: 驱动退出后 run.sh 把「入口 RUN_ID + 本次驱动 rc」显式传给本模块。校验：哨兵存在且
7: run_id==入口 RUN_ID、mode=targeted-reverify、settled==EXPECTED、唯一结算、计数和==
8: settled、**哨兵 final_exit == 本次驱动 rc**；任一不符 → 退出 1（run.sh 强制 4）。
9: 不依赖 `.last-reverify-run`（该文件仅作信息用途）。可单测。
10: """
11: from __future__ import annotations
12: 
13: import json
14: import pathlib
15: import sys
16: 
17: ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]          # backend/acceptance
18: REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"
19: LAST_RUN_FILE = REPORTS / ".last-reverify-run"   # 仅信息用途，不作为校验依据
20: EXPECTED_TARGETED = frozenset({f"RV-{i}" for i in range(1, 10)}
21:                               | {"CLEANUP", "CLEANUP-ports"})
22: KNOWN = ("pass", "fail", "blocked", "info")
23: 
24: 
25: def expected_exit(counts: dict, complete: bool) -> int:
26:     if counts.get("fail", 0) > 0 or counts.get("blocked", 0) > 0:
27:         return 1
28:     return 0 if complete else 4
29: 
30: 
31: def write_sentinel(run_id: str, settle: dict, rc: int, reports_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None) -> pathlib.Path:
32:     reports_dir = reports_dir or REPORTS
33:     counts = {k: int(settle["counts"].get(k, 0)) for k in KNOWN}
34:     complete = (not settle.get("missing") and not settle.get("extra")
35:                 and not settle.get("duplicates") and not settle.get("unknown_status")
36:                 and sum(counts.values()) == settle.get("rows") == settle.get("settled"))
37:     data = {"run_id": run_id, "mode": "targeted-reverify", "settled": settle["settled"],
38:             "expected": len(EXPECTED_TARGETED), "missing": settle.get("missing", []),
39:             "extra": settle.get("extra", []), "duplicates": settle.get("duplicates", []),
40:             "unknown_status": settle.get("unknown_status", []), "counts": counts,
41:             "counts_sum": sum(counts.values()), "rows": settle.get("rows"),
42:             "complete": complete, "final_exit": rc}
43:     d = reports_dir / run_id
44:     d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
45:     p = d / "reverify-sentinel.json"
46:     p.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
47:     (reports_dir / ".last-reverify-run").write_text(run_id + "\n", encoding="utf-8")  # 信息用
48:     return p
49: 
50: 
51: def verify(run_id: str, reports_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None,
52:            driver_rc: int | None = None) -> tuple[bool, str]:
53:     reports_dir = reports_dir or REPORTS
54:     p = reports_dir / run_id / "reverify-sentinel.json"
55:     if not p.exists():
56:         return False, f"本次 RUN_ID 哨兵缺失：{p}"
57:     try:
58:         d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
59:     except Exception as exc:
60:         return False, f"哨兵不可读：{exc}"
61:     if d.get("run_id") != run_id:
62:         return False, f"run_id 不匹配：{d.get('run_id')} != 入口 {run_id}"
63:     if d.get("mode") != "targeted-reverify":
64:         return False, f"mode 非法：{d.get('mode')}"
65:     if d.get("settled") != len(EXPECTED_TARGETED) or d.get("expected") != len(EXPECTED_TARGETED):
66:         return False, f"结算数不符：settled={d.get('settled')} expected={d.get('expected')}"
67:     for k in ("missing", "extra", "duplicates", "unknown_status"):
68:         if d.get(k):
69:             return False, f"{k} 非空：{d.get(k)}"
70:     counts = {k: int(d.get("counts", {}).get(k, 0)) for k in KNOWN}
71:     if sum(counts.values()) != d.get("rows") or d.get("rows") != d.get("settled"):
72:         return False, f"计数和!=行数/结算：sum={sum(counts.values())} rows={d.get('rows')}"
73:     want = expected_exit(counts, bool(d.get("complete")))
74:     if d.get("final_exit") != want:
75:         return False, f"哨兵 final_exit={d.get('final_exit')} 与政策 {want} 不一致"
76:     if driver_rc is not None and d.get("final_exit") != driver_rc:
77:         return False, f"哨兵 final_exit={d.get('final_exit')} != 本次驱动 rc={driver_rc}"
78:     return True, f"OK run_id={run_id} settled={d['settled']} counts={counts} exit={d['final_exit']}"
79:

82:     if not argv:
83:         print("usage: verify_reverify_sentinel.py <run_id> [driver_rc]", file=sys.stderr)
84:         return 2
85:     rid = argv[0]
86:     rc = int(argv[1]) if len(argv) > 1 else None
87:     ok, msg = verify(rid, driver_rc=rc)
88:     print(("REVERIFY_SENTINEL_OK " if ok else "REVERIFY_SENTINEL_FAIL ") + msg)
89:     return 0 if ok else 1

93:     raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # E 黑盒验收唯一入口：setup-venv | selfcheck | matrix
3: # 退出码：setup/selfcheck 0=成功 1=失败；
4: # matrix：0=94 场景全部真实通过（证据齐） 1=有失败 3=存在 dependency_pending
5: #         4=结算不完整/入口被篡改/哨兵校验失败。
6: # 双层防御 + 哨兵：
7: #   ① 拒绝外部 PYTEST_ADDOPTS 注入（-p no:framework.conftest 等禁用结算插件的
8: #      手段在进入 pytest 前即被拒绝 → 4）；运行时显式 env -u 清空并注入绑定的 RUN_ID。
9: #   ② pytest 退出后校验插件写出的结算哨兵 reports/<RUN_ID>/settlement.json
10: #      （存在、RUN_ID/mode 匹配、matrix 结算 94/94、四类计数与输出一致）；
11: #      哨兵缺失/不匹配 → 无视 pytest 退出码强制 4。裸调 pytest 不是验收入口。
12: set -u
13: cd "$(dirname "$0")"
14: VENV=.venv
15: PY="$VENV/bin/python"
16: PYTEST="$VENV/bin/pytest"
17: 
18: setup_venv() {
19:   if [ ! -x "$PYTEST" ]; then
20:     python3 -m venv "$VENV" || { echo "venv 创建失败"; return 1; }
21:   fi
22:   "$PY" -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt || { echo "依赖安装失败"; return 1; }
23:   echo "venv OK: $("$PY" --version) / pytest $("$PY" -c 'import pytest;print(pytest.__version__)')"
24: }
25: 
26: ensure_venv() {
27:   [ -x "$PYTEST" ] || setup_venv || exit 1
28: }
29: 
30: verify_sentinel() { # $1=sentinel $2=run_id $3=mode $4=log
31:   "$PY" - "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" <<'PYEOF'
32: import json, pathlib, re, sys
33: sent, rid, mode, log = sys.argv[1:5]
34: def fail(msg):
35:     print(f"SENTINEL_FAIL: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
36:     sys.exit(1)
37: p = pathlib.Path(sent)
38: if not p.exists():
39:     fail("结算哨兵缺失（插件被禁用或会话未正常结束），本次运行不可信")
40: try:
41:     d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
42: except Exception as e:
43:     fail(f"哨兵不可读：{e}")
44: if d.get("run_id") != rid:
45:     fail("哨兵 run_id 与入口绑定不一致")
46: if d.get("mode") != mode:
47:     fail("哨兵 mode 与入口不一致")
48: if d.get("completed") is not True:
49:     fail("哨兵缺少完成标记")
50: m = re.search(r"PASSED=(\d+) DEPENDENCY_PENDING=(\d+) FAILED=(\d+) SKIPPED_OTHER=(\d+)",
51:               pathlib.Path(log).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
52: if not m:
53:     fail("pytest 输出缺少 E 验收统计行")
54: c = d.get("counts", {})
55: if (int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3]), int(m[4])) != (
56:         c.get("passed"), c.get("pending"), c.get("failed"), c.get("skipped_other")):
57:     fail(f"汇总计数与哨兵不一致：输出{m.groups()} vs 哨兵{c}")
58: if mode == "matrix" and (d.get("settled_unique") != 94 or d.get("settlement_ok") is not True):
59:     fail(f"matrix 结算不完整：settled={d.get('settled_unique')}/94 ok={d.get('settlement_ok')}")
60: sys.exit(0)
61: PYEOF
62: }
63: 
64: run_pytest() { # $1=mode 其余=pytest 参数
65:   local mode="$1"; shift
66:   if [ -n "${PYTEST_ADDOPTS:-}" ]; then
67:     echo "run.sh: 拒绝外部 PYTEST_ADDOPTS 注入（会篡改插件/收集范围），强制 exit 4" >&2
68:     exit 4

3: 
4: The structural validator (openapi_spec_validator) only proves the document is
5: well-formed; it does NOT prove a real response body conforms. This script
6: resolves the ACTUAL response schema from openapi.yaml (no hardcoded copy) and
7: validates captured/real bodies against it.
8: 
9: OpenAPI 3.0.3 -> JSON Schema 2020-12 conversion is hand-rolled (no new pip
10: deps; jsonschema + pyyaml already ship in the contracts venv) and covers exactly
11: the constructs used by the validated paths:
12:   $ref (within-document, chained), type, nullable (3.0.3 semantics: type union
13:   null when nullable:true IN THE SAME Schema Object), enum, properties,
14:   required, additionalProperties, items, allOf/oneOf/anyOf, plus pass-through
15:   scalar keywords (format/pattern/min*/max*).
16: 
17: CLI:
18:     python3 scripts/validate_responses.py <body.json> ...   # exit 0 iff all valid
19:     python3 scripts/validate_responses.py --selftest        # bundled fixtures,
20:                                                             # positives PASS + negatives REJECTED
21: """
22: from __future__ import annotations
23: 
24: import json
25: import pathlib
26: import sys
27: from typing import Any, Callable
28: 
29: import yaml
30: from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
31: 
32: CONTRACTS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
33: OPENAPI_FILE = CONTRACTS / "openapi" / "openapi.yaml"
34: RESPONSES_DIR = CONTRACTS / "samples" / "responses"
35: 
36: ECHO_VIEW_PATH = "/api/v1/system/echo-jobs/{jobId}"
37: 
38: # Fixtures bundled with expected outcomes. Positive = must validate; negative =
39: # must be REJECTED (proves the validator discriminates, not accepts everything).
40: #
41: # echo-job-view-retryable.json is coherent with worker semantics: a retryable
42: # failure is re-queued (status=queued, finishedAt=null) while last_error carries
43: # retryable=true; reason=internal because the runtime's generic HANDLER_ERROR
44: # code is not on the safe whitelist.
45: POSITIVES = (
46:     "echo-job-view-succeeded.json",
47:     "echo-job-view-failed.json",
48:     "echo-job-view-retryable.json",
49: )
50: NEGATIVES = (
51:     "echo-job-view-unknown-field.json",
52:     "echo-job-view-bad-enum.json",
53:     "echo-job-view-null-in-nonnullable.json",
54: )
55: 
56: 
57: def _resolve_pointer(doc: Any, ref: str) -> Any:
58:     if not ref.startswith("#/"):
59:         raise ValueError(f"unsupported external $ref: {ref}")
60:     node = doc
61:     for part in ref[2:].split("/"):
62:         part = part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
63:         node = node[part]
64:     return node
65: 
66: 
67: def convert(node: Any, doc: Any, seen: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> Any:
68:     """OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema node -> JSON Schema 2020-12 (refs inlined)."""
69:     if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, dict):
70:         return node
71:     ref = node.get("$ref")
72:     if isinstance(ref, str):
73:         if ref in seen:
74:             raise ValueError(f"cyclic $ref: {ref}")
75:         target = convert(_resolve_pointer(doc, ref), doc, seen + (ref,))
76:         siblings = {k: v for k, v in node.items() if k != "$ref"}
77:         if not siblings:
78:             return target
79:         return {"allOf": [target, convert(siblings, doc, seen)]}
80: 
81:     out: dict = {}
82:     nullable = node.get("nullable") is True
83:     for key, value in node.items():
84:         if key == "nullable":
85:             continue
86:         if key == "properties":
87:             out[key] = {pk: convert(pv, doc, seen) for pk, pv in value.items()}
88:         elif key == "items":
89:             out[key] = convert(value, doc, seen)
90:         elif key == "additionalProperties":
91:             out[key] = convert(value, doc, seen) if isinstance(value, dict) else value
92:         elif key in ("allOf", "oneOf", "anyOf"):
93:             out[key] = [convert(x, doc, seen) for x in value]
94:         elif key == "not":
95:             out[key] = convert(value, doc, seen)
96:         else:
97:             out[key] = value
98: 
99:     if nullable:
100:         declared = out.get("type")
101:         if isinstance(declared, str):
102:             out["type"] = [declared, "null"]
103:         elif isinstance(declared, list):
104:             if "null" not in declared:
105:                 out["type"] = declared + ["null"]
106:         # else: OAS 3.0.3 `nullable` has NO effect without a `type` in this same
107:         # Schema Object (e.g. allOf/oneOf/anyOf + $ref + nullable). Do NOT broaden
108:         # to `{"anyOf": [..., null]}` — that masks the exact defect this validator
109:         # must catch: such schemas must REJECT null.
110:     return out
111: 
112: 
113: def _load_openapi() -> Any:
114:     return yaml.safe_load(OPENAPI_FILE.read_text("utf-8"))
115: 
116: 
117: def echo_response_schema(doc: Any = None) -> dict:
118:     """Resolve GET echo-jobs 200 application/json schema straight from the doc."""
119:     if doc is None:
120:         doc = _load_openapi()
121:     node = doc["paths"][ECHO_VIEW_PATH]["get"]["responses"]["200"]["content"][
122:         "application/json"
123:     ]["schema"]
124:     return convert(node, doc)
125: 
126: 
127: def build_validator() -> Draft202012Validator:
128:     return Draft202012Validator(echo_response_schema())
129: 
130: 
131: STATUS_VALID = "valid"
132: STATUS_SCHEMA_INVALID = "schema_invalid"
133: STATUS_LOAD_ERROR = "load_error"
134: 
135: 
136: def validate_path(path: pathlib.Path, validator: Draft202012Validator) -> tuple[str, str]:
137:     """Returns (status, detail) with status in valid|schema_invalid|load_error.
138: 
139:     load_error (unreadable/malformed JSON) is a HARNESS failure, never a schema
140:     rejection: callers must NOT count it as a discriminating negative.
141:     """
142:     try:
143:         instance = json.loads(pathlib.Path(path).read_text("utf-8"))
144:     except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
145:         return STATUS_LOAD_ERROR, f"cannot read/parse JSON: {exc}"
146:     errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(instance), key=lambda e: list(e.absolute_path))
147:     if not errors:
148:         return STATUS_VALID, ""
149:     detail = "; ".join(
150:         f"{e.json_path or '$'}: {e.validator or 'schema'} violated" for e in errors[:4]
151:     )
152:     return STATUS_SCHEMA_INVALID, detail
153: 
154: 
155: def _accepts(schema: Any, instance: Any) -> bool:
156:     return Draft202012Validator(schema).is_valid(instance)
157: 
158: 
159: def run_discrimination(emit) -> tuple[int, int]:
160:     """Prove the converter distinguishes the OLD broken nullable shape from the
161:     correct inline one. OAS 3.0.3: allOf+$ref+nullable WITHOUT local type must
162:     REJECT null (no null union); inline type+nullable must ACCEPT null."""
163:     old_doc = {"components": {"schemas": {"X": {
164:         "type": "object", "properties": {"a": {"type": "string"}},
165:         "required": ["a"], "additionalProperties": False}}}}
166:     old_schema = convert(
167:         {"allOf": [{"$ref": "#/components/schemas/X"}], "nullable": True}, old_doc)
168:     new_schema = convert(
169:         {"type": "object", "nullable": True, "properties": {"a": {"type": "string"}},
170:          "required": ["a"], "additionalProperties": False}, {})
171: 
172:     passed = failed = 0
173: 
174:     def check(label: str, condition: bool) -> None:
175:         nonlocal passed, failed
176:         if condition:
177:             passed += 1
178:             emit(label, True, "")
179:         else:
180:             failed += 1
181:             emit(label, False, "discrimination broken")
182: 
183:     check("nullable-shape: old allOf+$ref+nullable REJECTS null",
184:           not _accepts(old_schema, None))
185:     check("nullable-shape: old allOf+$ref+nullable ACCEPTS conforming object",
186:           _accepts(old_schema, {"a": "x"}))
187:     check("nullable-shape: new inline type+nullable ACCEPTS null",
188:           _accepts(new_schema, None))
189:     check("nullable-shape: new inline type+nullable ACCEPTS conforming object",
190:           _accepts(new_schema, {"a": "x"}))
191:     return passed, failed
192: 
193: 
194: def run_selftest(emit) -> tuple[int, int]:
195:     """emit(label, passed, detail). Returns (passed_checks, failed_checks)."""
196:     validator = build_validator()
197:     passed = failed = 0
198:     for name in POSITIVES:
199:         status, detail = validate_path(RESPONSES_DIR / name, validator)
200:         if status == STATUS_VALID:
201:             passed += 1
202:             emit(f"responses/{name} (positive accepted)", True, "")
203:         else:
204:             failed += 1
205:             emit(f"responses/{name} (positive accepted)", False,
206:                  detail if status == STATUS_SCHEMA_INVALID
207:                  else f"HARNESS: fixture did not load/parse ({detail})")
208:     for name in NEGATIVES:
209:         status, detail = validate_path(RESPONSES_DIR / name, validator)
210:         if status == STATUS_SCHEMA_INVALID:
211:             passed += 1
212:             emit(f"responses/{name} (negative rejected)", True, "")
213:         elif status == STATUS_LOAD_ERROR:
214:             failed += 1
215:             emit(f"responses/{name} (negative rejected)", False,
216:                  f"HARNESS: fixture did not load/parse ({detail})")
217:         else:
218:             failed += 1
219:             emit(f"responses/{name} (negative rejected)", False,
220:                  "validator ACCEPTED an invalid body (no discrimination)")
221:     dpassed, dfailed = run_discrimination(emit)
222:     return passed + dpassed, failed + dfailed
223: 
224: 
225: def _cli_selftest() -> int:
226:     def emit(label: str, passed: bool, detail: str) -> None:
227:         print(("ok   " if passed else "FAIL ") + label + ("" if passed else f": {detail}"))
228: 
229:     passed, failed = run_selftest(emit)
230:     print(f"\nselftest: {passed} checks passed, {failed} failed "
231:           f"({len(POSITIVES)} positives, {len(NEGATIVES)} negatives, "
232:           f"4 nullable-shape discrimination)")
233:     print("RESULT: " + ("PASS" if failed == 0 else "FAIL"))
234:     return 0 if failed == 0 else 1
235: 
236: 
237: def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
238:     if argv == ["--selftest"]:
239:         return _cli_selftest()
240:     if not argv:
241:         print("usage: validate_responses.py <body.json>... | --selftest", file=sys.stderr)
242:         return 2
243:     validator = build_validator()
244:     rc = 0
245:     for raw in argv:
246:         path = pathlib.Path(raw)
247:         status, detail = validate_path(path, validator)
248:         if status == STATUS_VALID:
249:             print(f"ok   {path}")
250:         elif status == STATUS_LOAD_ERROR:
251:             print(f"FAIL {path}: HARNESS load error: {detail}")
252:             rc = 1
253:         else:
254:             print(f"FAIL {path}: {detail}")
255:             rc = 1
256:     print("RESULT: " + ("PASS" if rc == 0 else "FAIL"))
257:     return rc
258: 
259: 
260: if __name__ == "__main__":
261:     raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Verify backend/contracts/samples against the shared contract schemas.
3: 
4: 1. Every samples/jobs/*.json payload validates against its JSON Schema
5:    (draft 2020-12, schemas/ directory, cross-file $refs via registry).
6: 2. Envelope & multipart-metadata samples validate against the OpenAPI
7:    components/schemas they are governed by (openapi/openapi.yaml), after a
8:    minimal OpenAPI-3.0 -> JSON-Schema-2020-12 adaptation (nullable handling,
9:    component $ref rewriting).
10: 3. Every canonicalization vector's expected_sha256 is recomputed with the
11:    reference RFC 8785 implementation in scripts/jcs.py.
12: 
13: Exit code is nonzero on any failure. Run from anywhere:
14:     python3 scripts/validate_samples.py
15: """
16: from __future__ import annotations
17: 
18: import json
19: import pathlib
20: import sys
21: 
22: CONTRACTS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
23: sys.path.insert(0, str(CONTRACTS / "scripts"))
24: 
25: import jcs  # noqa: E402  (reference JCS implementation)
26: import yaml  # noqa: E402
27: from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator  # noqa: E402
28: from referencing import Registry, Resource  # noqa: E402
29: 
30: SCHEMAS_DIR = CONTRACTS / "schemas"
31: OPENAPI_FILE = CONTRACTS / "openapi" / "openapi.yaml"
32: SAMPLES = CONTRACTS / "samples"
33: 
34: FAILURES: list[str] = []
35: CHECKS = 0
36: 
37: 
38: def fail(label: str, detail: str) -> None:
39:     FAILURES.append(f"{label}: {detail}")
40:     print(f"FAIL {label}: {detail}")
41: 
42: 
43: def ok(label: str) -> None:
44:     global CHECKS
45:     CHECKS += 1
46:     print(f"ok   {label}")
47: 
48: 
49: def load_json(path: pathlib.Path):
50:     return jcs.load_strict(path.read_text("utf-8"))
51: 
52: 
53: # ---------------- JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) ----------------
54: 
55: def jsonschema_registry() -> Registry:
56:     resources = []
57:     for p in sorted(SCHEMAS_DIR.glob("*.json")):
58:         contents = json.loads(p.read_text("utf-8"))
59:         sid = contents.get("$id")
60:         if not sid:
61:             fail("schema-ids", f"{p.name} has no $id")
62:             continue
63:         resources.append((sid, Resource.from_contents(contents)))
64:     return Registry().with_resources(resources)
65: 
66: 
67: def validate_with_jsonschema(instance, schema_uri: str, registry: Registry, label: str) -> None:
68:     schema_resource = registry.contents(schema_uri)
69:     validator = Draft202012Validator(schema_resource, registry=registry)
70:     errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(instance), key=lambda e: e.json_path)
71:     if errors:
72:         fail(label, "; ".join(f"{e.json_path}: {e.message}" for e in errors[:5]))
73:     else:
74:         ok(label)
75: 
76: 
77: JOB_PAYLOAD_MAP = {
78:     "system-echo.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-system-echo.json",
79:     "assessment-analyze.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-assessment-analyze.json",
80:     "identity-enroll.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-identity-enroll.json",
81:     "plan-generate.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-plan-generate.json",
82:     "notification-deliver.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-notification-deliver.json",
83:     "media-cleanup.json": "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:payload-media-cleanup.json",
84: }
85: 
86: 
87: # ---------------- OpenAPI 3.0 -> JSON Schema adaptation ----------------
88: 
89: def openapi_to_jsonschema(node):
90:     """Recursively adapt OpenAPI 3.0 schema objects to draft 2020-12."""
91:     if isinstance(node, list):
92:         return [openapi_to_jsonschema(x) for x in node]
93:     if not isinstance(node, dict):
94:         return node
95:     node = {k: openapi_to_jsonschema(v) for k, v in node.items()}
96:     # rewrite component refs to absolute registry URNs
97:     ref = node.get("$ref")
98:     if isinstance(ref, str) and ref.startswith("#/components/schemas/"):
99:         node["$ref"] = f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{ref.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]}"
100:     # drop OpenAPI-only keywords unknown to strict vocabularies (harmless annotations)
101:     nullable = node.pop("nullable", False)
102:     node.pop("example", None)
103:     node.pop("discriminator", None)
104:     if nullable is True:
105:         if "type" in node and isinstance(node["type"], str):
106:             node["type"] = [node["type"], "null"]
107:         elif "allOf" in node:
108:             node = {"anyOf": [node, {"type": "null"}]}
109:     return node
110: 
111: 
112: def openapi_registry() -> Registry:
113:     doc = yaml.safe_load(OPENAPI_FILE.read_text("utf-8"))
114:     components = doc["components"]["schemas"]
115:     resources = []
116:     for name, schema in components.items():
117:         adapted = openapi_to_jsonschema(schema)
118:         adapted["$schema"] = "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
119:         adapted["$id"] = f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{name}"
120:         resources.append((adapted["$id"], Resource.from_contents(adapted)))
121:     return Registry().with_resources(resources)
122: 
123: 
124: def validate_with_openapi(instance, component: str, registry: Registry, label: str) -> None:
125:     resource = registry.contents(f"urn:mvp:contracts:openapi:{component}")
126:     validator = Draft202012Validator(resource, registry=registry)
127:     errors = sorted(validator.iter_errors(instance), key=lambda e: e.json_path)
128:     if errors:
129:         fail(label, "; ".join(f"{e.json_path}: {e.message}" for e in errors[:5]))
130:     else:
131:         ok(label)
132: 
133: 
134: # ---------------- canonicalization vectors ----------------
135: 
136: def check_vectors() -> None:
137:     path = SAMPLES / "canonicalization" / "vectors.json"
138:     vectors = load_json(path)
139:     if not isinstance(vectors, list) or not vectors:
140:         fail("vectors", "vectors.json must be a non-empty array")
141:         return
142:     seen = set()
143:     for v in vectors:
144:         name = v.get("name", "<unnamed>")
145:         if name in seen:
146:             fail("vectors-dup-name", name)
147:         seen.add(name)
148:         actual = jcs.sha256_hex(v["input"])
149:         if actual != v["expected_sha256"]:
150:             fail(f"vector {name}", f"expected {v['expected_sha256']} got {actual}")
151:         else:
152:             ok(f"vector {name}")
153:     by_name = {v["name"]: v["expected_sha256"] for v in vectors}
154:     pairs = [
155:         ("nested-out-of-order-keys-a", "nested-out-of-order-keys-b-equal-hash-to-a", True),
156:         ("defaults-expanded-equal-pair-a", "defaults-expanded-equal-pair-b-equal-hash-to-a", True),
157:         ("array-order-significant-front-left-right", "array-order-significant-reversed-different-hash", False),
158:         ("near-collision-closure-final-count-3", "near-collision-closure-final-count-4-different-hash", False),
159:     ]
160:     for a, b, equal in pairs:
161:         if a not in by_name or b not in by_name:
162:             fail("vector-pair", f"missing {a or b}")
163:             continue
164:         if (by_name[a] == by_name[b]) != equal:
165:             fail("vector-pair", f"{a} vs {b}: expected equal={equal}")
166:         else:
167:             ok(f"vector pair {a} {'==' if equal else '!='} {b}")
168: 
169: 
170: def main() -> int:
171:     print("== JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) job/payload samples ==")
172:     reg = jsonschema_registry()
173:     for fname, uri in JOB_PAYLOAD_MAP.items():
174:         validate_with_jsonschema(load_json(SAMPLES / "jobs" / fname), uri, reg, f"samples/jobs/{fname}")
175:     validate_with_jsonschema(
176:         load_json(SAMPLES / "jobs" / "job-handoff-example.json"),
177:         "urn:mvp:contracts:schemas:job-async_jobs.json", reg,
178:         "samples/jobs/job-handoff-example.json",
179:     )
180: 
181:     print("== OpenAPI components/schemas envelope & metadata samples ==")
182:     oreg = openapi_registry()
183:     validate_with_openapi(load_json(SAMPLES / "envelopes" / "success-envelope.json"), "SuccessEnvelope", oreg, "success-envelope.json")
184:     list_page = load_json(SAMPLES / "envelopes" / "list-page.json")
185:     validate_with_openapi(list_page, "SuccessEnvelope", oreg, "list-page.json (envelope)")
186:     validate_with_openapi(list_page["data"], "MemberAccessGrantListData", oreg, "list-page.json (data=MemberAccessGrantListData)")
187:     validate_with_openapi(load_json(SAMPLES / "envelopes" / "error-envelope.json"), "ErrorEnvelope", oreg, "error-envelope.json")
188:     err = load_json(SAMPLES / "envelopes" / "error-envelope.json")
189:     if err["error"]["code"] != "DEVICE_OCCUPIED":
190:         fail("error-envelope", "expected DEVICE_OCCUPIED sample")
191:     else:
192:         ok("error-envelope.json code=DEVICE_OCCUPIED")
193:     ni = load_json(SAMPLES / "envelopes" / "not-implemented-501.json")
194:     validate_with_openapi(ni, "ErrorEnvelope", oreg, "not-implemented-501.json (ErrorEnvelope)")
195:     validate_with_openapi(ni, "NotImplementedEnvelope", oreg, "not-implemented-501.json (NotImplementedEnvelope)")
196:     if ni["error"]["code"] != "NOT_IMPLEMENTED":
197:         fail("not-implemented-501", "expected code NOT_IMPLEMENTED")
198:     else:
199:         ok("not-implemented-501.json code=NOT_IMPLEMENTED")
200:     validate_with_openapi(load_json(SAMPLES / "multipart-metadata" / "m1a01-metadata.json"), "M1A01Metadata", oreg, "m1a01-metadata.json")
201:     validate_with_openapi(load_json(SAMPLES / "multipart-metadata" / "m3a01-metadata.json"), "M3A01Metadata", oreg, "m3a01-metadata.json")
202: 
203:     print("== canonicalization vectors (recomputed with scripts/jcs.py) ==")
204:     check_vectors()
205: 
206:     print("== strict echo-jobs 200 response schema (scripts/validate_responses.py) ==")
207:     import validate_responses  # noqa: E402  (same scripts/ dir)
208:     validate_responses.run_selftest(
209:         lambda label, passed, detail: ok(label) if passed else fail(label, detail or "invalid")
210:     )
211: 
212:     print(f"\n{CHECKS} checks passed, {len(FAILURES)} failed")
213:     if FAILURES:
214:         print("RESULT: FAIL", file=sys.stderr)
215:         return 1
216:     print("RESULT: PASS — all samples valid, all canonicalization vectors match")
217:     return 0
218: 
219: 
220: if __name__ == "__main__":
221:     raise SystemExit(main())
